apiGateway.title: API Gateway
apiGateway.subtitle: Security & routing
apiGateway.description: A single entry point for all your APIs, handling security, smart routing and traffic management.
benefits: Stronger security through a single control point
Less complexity on the client side

identityServer.title: Identity Server
identityServer.subtitle: Access management
identityServer.description: A complete identity and access management (IAM) solution to secure your applications and services.
benefits: A simpler experience for users, thanks to SSO
Compliance with regulations such as GDPR

orchestrator.title: Orchestrator
orchestrator.subtitle: Synchronous & asynchronous
orchestrator.description: A smart orchestration engine to coordinate your services and complex business processes.
features: Orchestration of synchronous and asynchronous services
benefits: Greater resilience through automatic error handling

processExecutor.title: Process Executor
processExecutor.subtitle: Process automation
processExecutor.description: A process execution engine to automate your workflows.
